content:
**"The stars began to die the moment the signal reached them, each fading sun a syllable in the alien reply to a question humanity should never have phrased."**  

This opening blends mystery, cosmic stakes, and existential consequence, inviting curiosity about the forbidden inquiry, the nature of the message, and the unraveling fate of the universe—all while grounding the grandeur in human agency.
